faqs.q: Sec. 42-72. - I.F.C. Section 901.6, Inspection, testing and maintenance.
faqs.a:
Section 901.6 Inspection, testing and maintenance
, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"901.6 Inspection, testing and maintenance.
Fire detection and alarm systems, emergency alarm systems, gas detection systems,
                  fire-extinguishing systems, mechanical smoke exhaust systems and smoke and heat vents
                  shall be maintained in an operative condition at all times and shall be replaced or
                  repaired where defective. Nonrequired
fire protection systems
and equipment shall be inspected, tested and maintained or removed. The removal of
                  any non-required
fire protection system
or equipment shall be
approved
by the fire district."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
